sources.N: nlbair/ufc-data v0.1.1 (Noah Bair 2026, CC BY 4.0, doi:10.5281/zenodo.23458636); round scores from MMA Decisions, stats from ufcstats.com
sources.D: martindavies-code/ufc-judging-analysis (Martin Davies 2026, no license file; private research use, credited); round scores parsed from MMA Decisions
sources.why_not_mmadecisions_direct: mmadecisions.com/robots.txt disallows all agents except listed search engines

meta.orientation: every [a, b] pair is [A, B] = the two names of the ufcstats BOUT string in order
meta.scores: rounds/total are published scores (after point deductions; they add up to the official totals); raw (only where it differs) adds the deducted point back = the judge's view of the round. raw_known=false (source D only) means deductions cannot be separated.

checks._period: dev fights only (before 2026-01-01); vault-period counts are in the vault file

N_deduction_patches.source: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UFC_285 results note: 'Saaimann was deducted 1 point in round 1 due to multiple groin strikes'. N's raw columns show no deduction, which leaves Byrd's published round 1 as 9-9; with the point added back to B all three ufcstats totals still reconcile (26-29, 27-28, 28-28).

meta.judges_table_note: judges{} aggregates (rounds, share_10_8_plus, share_10_10, dissent_rate, first, last) span the whole dev period 2006-2025, including the 2024-2025 validation years. They are descriptive and NOT walk-forward safe as model inputs; use the jp_* columns of judgerounds_rows.json scores (history strictly before each fight date) instead.
